title: Bounded computation segment
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine, let $F$ be a set of states, let $P$ be a property of work-tape head-position vectors, and let $a,b$ be configurations on the same input. A segment of length $t$ from $a$ to $b$ means that running $M$ from $a$ for $t$ steps reaches $b$, the state is outside $F$ at every time strictly before $t$, and the head-position vector satisfies $P$ at every time up to and including $t$.
hypotheses_covered: State is outside $F$ at every time less than $t$
Head-position vector satisfies $P$ at every time at most $t$
